# route-map-matching

> Open-source GPS map matching library for JavaScript, TypeScript and PHP. It snaps noisy GPS traces onto the roads a vehicle actually drove, using a hidden Markov model with Viterbi decoding, and runs in the browser, Node.js or PHP with identical results, no routing server and no dependencies. MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Install with `npm install route-map-matching` (ES modules, CommonJS, TypeScript types, also loadable from a CDN with no build step) or `composer require rprasetya/route-map-matching` (PHP 8.2 or newer).
- Over 100,000 GPS points per second in Node.js 22; 1,000 points match in about 16 ms and 20,000 points in about 150 ms on a laptop. 4.5 to 8 times faster than the production engine it was extracted from, with the same output.
- Main functions: `buildNetwork(roads)`, `matchPoints(points, network, options)`, `matchCoordinates(coordinates, network, options)`, `snapToRoad(network, [lng, lat], radius)`, and `createTileSource({ url })` to read roads straight from Mapbox vector tiles (OpenMapTiles and Protomaps schemas). PHP has the same API as `Network::build` and `Matcher::matchPoints`.
- Handles one-way streets, divided roads, GPS gaps, spikes, detours and false U-turns. Knows which side of the road traffic drives on in 75 countries and territories and uses it by default.
- Coordinates are `[lng, lat]` in degrees.
- Unlike the map matching services of OSRM, Valhalla or GraphHopper, it needs no server: roads come from your own data or from the vector tiles your map already loads, so matching can run on the client, in a serverless function or inside a PHP app.

- [README](https://github.com/rprasetya/route-map-matching/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start in JavaScript, TypeScript and PHP, API, options, how it works, benchmarks
- [Full documentation as plain text](https://route-map-matching.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): the README in one file
- [Live demo and documentation site](https://route-map-matching.vercel.app/): simulate a drive or place your own GPS points and watch them snap to the road
- [Changelog](https://github.com/rprasetya/route-map-matching/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
